description: Hartlepool Borough Council is a unitary authority publishing a single quarterly payments-over-£500 feed (XLSX, 13 cols) with an embedded Card Transaction flag (card rows tagged type=purchase_cards at ETL). ASC + children's services mean the feed carries REDACTED Care Act direct-payment rows (~1,194 across 2022/23-2025/26) — routed to direct_payment_individual to keep them out of HHI / supplier-league / duplicate analyses. Default: procurement_paid.

match.supplier_regex: ^(\[REDACTED\]|REDACT(ED)?([ \-,].*)?|NAME WITHHELD|PAYMENT TO AN INDIVIDUAL|PAYMENT TO INDIVIDUAL)$

rules.reason: Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR personal-data redactions — direct payments to individuals (foster carers, SGO recipients, ASC service-user direct payments). Suffix-tolerant regex shared with Gateshead/Blackpool/Blackburn/LCC. Lawfully unnamed.
Default for Hartlepool. Single quarterly feed, no PO/invoice split; card transactions carry type=purchase_cards which is also a paid outflow.
